metallib_source: Matching v0.3.3-alpha official RedlampKernels.framework; shader sources are retained under packages/RedlampKernels. Set PHOTOLAB_COMPILE_METAL=1 to rebuild with Apple's optional Metal toolchain.
changes: PhotoLab adds relative white balance and automatic white balance for rendered RGB in RedlampEngine/Sources/ImageSession.swift and RedlampEngine.swift. The RAW white-balance path and Metal shaders are unchanged. PhotoLab bridge and build tooling live outside this directory.
